build_sagemaker_api_router: build a FastAPI app with SageMaker-compatible ping and invocations endpoints for vLLM model serving
attach_router_to_fastapi: attach a SageMaker API router to a FastAPI app with supported tasks and optional model config
bootstrap_sagemaker_standards: bootstrap SageMaker container standards on a FastAPI application instance
route_invocations_by_request_type: route SageMaker invocations to appropriate handlers based on request body validation against invocation types
